name: Audi R8 Coupé V10 RWD
description: The Audi R8 V10 RWD represents a purer, driver-focused variant of Audi's mid-engine supercar, introduced in 2020 as part of the second-generation R8 lineup. Unlike the standard quattro models, the RWD version sends all 570 hp from its naturally aspirated 5.2-liter V10 engine exclusively to the rear wheels, creating a more engaging and playful driving experience. The FSI direct-injection V10, shared with the Lamborghini Huracan, produces 550 Nm of torque and revs to 8,700 rpm with an intoxicating naturally aspirated soundtrack. Power is delivered through a seven-speed S tronic dual-clutch transmission. Weighing 1,595 kg, the rear-wheel-drive configuration offers 55 kg of weight savings over the quattro variant. The R8 V10 RWD accelerates from 0-100 km/h in 3.7 seconds with a top speed of 320 km/h, offering supercar performance with a more tail-happy character that purists appreciate.
author: High Speed x Navva
